title: Further increase MATRIX_LR to 0.075
description: Increased Muon learning rate for transformer matrices from 0.06 to 0.075 (1.25x) to continue Round 2's successful optimization strategy.
reflection: Result: val_bpb 0.996000 (no change from baseline 0.996000). The MATRIX_LR optimization appears to have plateaued at 0.06. Round 2's 1.5x increase (0.04→0.06) provided measurable gains (~0.0006), but the additional 1.25x step (0.06→0.075) yielded no improvement. This suggests either: (1) we've reached the local optimum on this parameter, (2) the metric variance masks small effects below ~0.0001, or (3) overshooting stability is a concern even at modest increments. The Muon learning rate lever appears exhausted; future rounds should explore other parameters (EMBEDDING_LR, weight decay, batch size) or accept diminishing returns.
